# sherpa-node-row

One row of a [sherpa-node](sherpa-node.md): the node's three columns, an input socket's cell, its content (a label or a field) and an output socket's cell. Any of the three may be empty. Each socket stands in its SOCKET TAB, outside the card. Will, TODOs 78, 887.

## When to use it

For one row of a `sherpa-node`: an input socket, a field and an output socket, each one optional. The field is a `sherpa-input-text` — text, a select or a number — and names itself; a row with no field names itself with `data-label`. For the whole node's sockets, set them on the node.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-node data-heading="Filter" data-icon="filter" data-input-socket="object"><sherpa-node-row><sherpa-input-text data-label="Key" name="key" data-type="select"></sherpa-input-text></sherpa-node-row><sherpa-node-row data-input-socket="value" data-input-routed><sherpa-input-text data-label="Value" name="value" value="active"></sherpa-input-text></sherpa-node-row><sherpa-node-row data-label="Matches" data-output-socket="boolean"></sherpa-node-row></sherpa-node>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-collapsed` | boolean |  | its node is collapsed: its sockets stand in the node's stacks. Its host writes it data-input-at, data-output-at its sockets' places in the node's stacks, from 0, collapsed. Its host writes them data-input-at-routed, data-output-at-routed the same, among the routed only; unset, the socket is not routed |
| `data-input-at` | number |  |  |
| `data-input-at-routed` | number |  |  |
| `data-input-many` | boolean |  | the input takes several routes: its socket is a double height D |
| `data-input-routed` | boolean |  | a route joins the input: its socket is filled, else hollow |
| `data-input-socket` | `value` `object` `boolean` `any` |  | an input socket on the start edge: value \| object \| boolean \| any: an input is a D, its type in its ink |
| `data-label` | text |  | the row's name, when it has no field: a field names itself |
| `data-output-at` | number |  |  |
| `data-output-at-routed` | number |  |  |
| `data-output-routed` | boolean |  | a route leaves the output: its socket is filled, else hollow |
| `data-output-socket` | `value` `object` `boolean` |  | an output socket on the end edge: value (a circle) \| object (a diamond) \| boolean (a circle) |
| `data-property` | boolean |  | a property: its label reads in the input value's own type |
| `data-socket-name` | text |  | the row's name, the first line of each socket's tip: a collapsed node shows no label |
| `data-socket-value` | text |  | the row's value in words, a line of each socket's tip; unset, the line hides |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `socketRect(side: SocketSide)` | A socket's box on the screen, for a connector to join; null when the row has none. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | input | the field: a [sherpa-input-text](sherpa-input-text.md) — a text field, a select or a number |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`content`, `label`, `row`, `socket-in`, `socket-out`, `socket-tab-in`, `socket-tab-out`, `tip`
